text:
matt_jensen: Hey support — noticed our promo credits were consumed out of order and we got charged on invoice INV-2026-042 even though dashboard shows 1,200 promo credits remaining. Can you check? Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/abc
jamie_support: Sorry about that — we're looking. Can you paste the account id + invoice id? Also any request ids from the API responses would help.
matt_jensen: account: acct_7Zxq, invoice: INV-2026-042. API request header returned X-Request-ID: req_4a1b2c. Repro steps: we call /v1/generate ~1500 tokens, response shows usage.tokens: 1500 but promo_credits_applied: 0 even though dashboard shows promo pool >0.
jamie_support: Got it. Can you paste the curl you used (sanitized key ok)? I'll pull the request logs.
matt_jensen: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"long prompt..."}' -i
...Response headers include: X-Request-ID: req_4a1b2c
Body: {"id":"resp_01","usage":{"tokens":1500}, "output":"..."}
```  
We didn't see any promo credits applied.
jamie_support: Thanks — pulling ledger and usage now.
jamie_support: (internal) running: `SELECT * FROM promo_consumptions WHERE account_id='acct_7Zxq' AND invoice_id='INV-2026-042' ORDER BY consumed_at;`  
Result snippet: ```
promo_id | consumed_amount | expires_at        | consumed_at
promo_2026_may | 300 | 2026-05-31 23:59 | 2026-03-01 09:12
promo_2026_apr | 1000| 2026-04-30 23:59 | 2026-03-01 09:12
```  
Looks like a promo expiring later (May) was consumed before the April promo.
lia_billing: tagging billing team — that ordering shouldn't happen, we apply oldest-expiry-first (FIFO by expiry). Can you dump the selection query?Billing bot printed invoice lines: `line 3: usage 1500 tokens charged $0.15, promo_applied: promo_2026_apr=0, promo_2026_may=1500`  
arjun_eng-billing: I think I see root cause — credit selection routine sorts by `expires_at DESC` by mistake when multiple promos exist with overlapping usable windows (migration logic introduced last week). That would burn newest promos first (LIFO). Can you run a quick test query?  
Suggested check: `SELECT promo_id, expires_at FROM promos WHERE account_id='acct_7Zxq' ORDER BY expires_at ASC;` and compare to the consumption order.
jamie_support: Ran it: promos for account are: promo_2026_apr (expires 2026-04-30), promo_2026_may (expires 2026-05-31). Consumption showed May applied first. Found in code: `ORDER BY expires_at DESC` in `apply_promo_credits()` — looks like a regression from the promo migration PR.
arjun_eng-billing: Escalating to P1 and assigning INF-3245. Immediate mitigation: 1) issue corrective credit for INV-2026-042 and mark invoice as adjusted, 2) patch selection to `ORDER BY expires_at ASC` and deploy hotfix, 3) backfill consumption records for any affected accounts and re-run invoice calculation overnight. Lia — can you process the refund/adjustment now?
lia_billing: Will issue a $96.50 credit against INV-2026-042 and create an adjusted invoice. Also flagging finance to stop automated collections for this invoice. I'll DM matt to confirm.
matt_jensen: Thanks — appreciate the quick response. ETA for the fix?
arjun_eng-billing: Hotfix being prepared now, target deploy in ~3 hours. We'll run a smoke test against test account and then prod. I'll follow up in this thread when deployed and postmortem ready.
jamie_support: Following up: I've added the account to the backfill list and will monitor. @matt_jensen I'll DM the invoice details and confirm the credit once issued. :thumbsup:
matt_jensen: Thanks all — please keep me posted. :pray:
